title: VTA Collection — List — payload
description: A client with standing in a trust context lists, for every identifier there that its VTA collects for unless a client has claimed it, who collects for it now: the VTA, a claimant — with the claim's end and whether it can be renewed — or nobody, and why (VTI-NTF-091). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

collector.description: Only identifiers with this collector — `none`, for instance, to find the identifiers nobody collects for.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same filters. The VTA refuses one it did not issue.

Response.title: VTA Collection — List — response payload
Response.description: One page of the identifiers that match.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
